Oh McDonald's, one time many years ago your golden arches and fries danced in the minds of children as the perfect way for mom or dad to express their love for their little ones. Now, all grown up with graying hair and stubble, (metaphorically I suppose), your dollar menu seems like a cheap hooker trying to garner business over the stench of bad perfume, wobbling along the alley at night.

What was once a flourishing empire is now one in decline, hundreds of franchised restaurants will be closing this year in North America alone, and stern warnings have emerged from earnings calls to the wall street boys - don't expect per share revenue to be pulling out of the nosedive just yet.

So what does a fast food CEO do? Change products? Increase quality? No, they grab on to the fading comet of hipster-ism and cling as tight as they can. On the back of re-imagining the hamburgler as a hipster 20-something, its been announced that Kale, that pseudo-edible vegetable, will be added to the menu somehow.
